description: This file contains test code for the Coocook::Model::Ingredients module, including tests for methods like as_arrayref, factor, all_articles, and all_units, as well as usage of Test2::V0 testing framework.

methods.name: as_arrayref
methods.description: Returns the ingredients as an array reference of hashes with fields like value, unit, article, and comment.

methods.name: factor
methods.description: Sets a multiplication factor for the ingredients.

methods.name: all_articles
methods.description: Returns all articles associated with the ingredients, each with a name and list of units.

methods.name: all_units
methods.description: Returns all units available for ingredients, each with short and long names.
